title: cite review commit — stdin payload contract
description: The JSON payload `cite review commit` reads from STDIN (stdin, never argv — Windows 32K argv limit; the bytes MUST be UTF-8, optionally BOM-prefixed). SINGLE SOURCE the Step-8 skills validate against. Sync-by-construction (no jsonschema dependency): src/citation_needed/review.py defines pydantic mirrors (CommitPayload / ChoiceEntry / CitationEntry) with extra='forbid'; every payload is validated through them before any write, and tests/test_review.py asserts each $defs entry's properties + required lists (and the enum value sets) match the models exactly, so this file and the code cannot drift. Anti-fabrication: there is deliberately NO field for fetched page text AND NO field for an API echo — a web_fetch_verified entry is re-fetched and quote-re-verified server-side by the CLI through verify.fetch_url, and an api_structured entry's echo is captured server-side by the CLI's OWN structured-API lookup (DOI via Crossref; arXiv/S2 paper URL via Semantic Scholar), with the payload's claimed title required to match the retrieved title; a payload carrying fetched_text or api_echo is rejected outright.

choices.description: Every choice observed THIS review. choice_keys present in the DB but absent here are marked status='removed' (never deleted — their citations remain corpus assets). Duplicate keys are rejected.

run_id.description: Optional when --run is passed on the command line; when both are present they must agree.

choice_key.description: Kebab slug; the durable identity. REUSE the prior run's key for the same underlying decision even if reworded (the open output supplies the prior pairs); mint a new key only for a genuinely new choice.

quote.description: The literal extracted span text (stored as choices.quote_or_span; its sha256 is the byte-identical reuse fast path).

span_end_line.description: Locator only, never identity — must be >= span_start_line.

category.description: One of the 11 taxonomy categories (prompts/classification.v1.md). Also seeds the citation keywords for FTS5 corpus-first search.

votes.description: One dimension label per judge call, k>=3. A judge call whose output could not be parsed arrives as the literal 'parse-failed' and is force-scored contradicted, counted in the denominator. A majority tie MUST be escalated (k=5, then 7) before commit — a tie reaching commit rejects the whole payload.

source_path.description: File the span was actually extracted from when it differs from the artifact's own file (pointer-resolved skills/plans, CLAUDE.md @-imports, evals/ sidecars). Null/omitted means the artifact's own file.

literature_searched.description: Was an external search actually attempted for this choice.

literature_found.description: Did the search return anything usable. searched=true + found=false is the first-class no-literature-found result.

search_queries.description: The actual query strings tried — REQUIRED non-empty whenever literature_searched is true, so a null result is auditable, never a black box.

suggestions.description: Actionable suggestions; expected for every needs-improvement choice (rendered in the breakdown).

CitationEntry.description: Exactly one of three shapes: (1) EXISTING LINK — citation_id, or kind + natural_key (identity is UNIQUE(kind, natural_key)); (2) NEW EXTERNAL — resolution_method 'api_structured' with a locator (doi, or an arxiv.org/semanticscholar.org paper url) + the claimed title (the CLI performs the structured-API lookup ITSELF, captures the API's own JSON response as the stored echo, and rejects the whole payload on a title mismatch — a caller-supplied api_echo is never accepted), or 'web_fetch_verified' with url + quote (the CLI re-fetches the url itself via the SSRF-guarded seam and re-verifies the quote — caller-supplied page text is never accepted); (3) NEW INTERNAL — resolution_method 'internal-read' with workspace_path + quote, read-verified against the actual file (the path is confined to the workspace root, or to the memory root for memory:-scheme locators — escapes reject the payload). All inserts go through verify.insert_citation, the sole writer.

relevance_note.description: Per-link relevance, required — never a bare join.

citation_id.description: Existing-link form 1: a citations.id (e.g. from corpus-search).

natural_key.description: Existing-link form 2: the normalized DOI / normalized URL / workspace path; requires kind.

title.description: Retrieved title — required for every new record.

quote.description: Supporting quote for web_fetch_verified (matched against the server-side re-fetch) and internal-read (matched against the actual file).

source_line_ref.description: Internal only: 'path:line' locator at verification time (drifts).

keywords.description: FTS5 corpus terms; defaults to the choice's category.
